summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py (thread-entry state initialised in __init__, set/cleared in run_async with a finally, not-running and same-thread checks, scheduling via run_coroutine_threadsafe through invoke and _set_active). Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 8 passing tests when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at the generated src. The rest of the suite shows the same 68 failures as the base checkout, caused by the missing async pytest plugin. Nothing committed; the venv's editable install points at base, so PYTHONPATH was needed.
